title: tx_queue_empty _Nonnull annotation contradicts documented NULL handling
description:
Parameter marked _Nonnull but doc says 'NULL returns true'. Implementation confirms NULL is handled (returns true). Annotation should be _Nullable; current state misleads static analyzers and callers about the contract.
